inputs.original_text: Tensions in Nigeria’s health sector escalated on Thursday as workers under the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations took to the streets in Abuja, protesting controversial reform bills currently before the National Assembly. The demonstrators gathered at the Unity Fountain in Maitama, voicing strong opposition to the proposed legislation, which [...] The post Health sector tensions boil over as workers protest reform bills in Abuja appeared first on Latest Nigeria News | Top Stories from Ripples Nigeria .
inputs.modified_text: Health workers from the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations protested at Unity Fountain in Maitama, Abuja, on Thursday against reform bills before the National Assembly. Their warning is simple: healthcare policy cannot be imposed on the people who keep the system running. When workers are shut out, it is patients—especially those already facing unequal access—who risk paying the price. Lawmakers should listen to frontline staff and put patients and public health ahead of reforms that could deepen inequality.
